analytical_dimensions.description: An axis that organises the encounter
probing_questions: Which two to four axes organise the whole meeting of the two systems?
On this axis, is the owner's position parallel, colliding, overlapping then diverging, absorbing, or is the axis irrelevant — with ours, theirs, the bridge, and the parts it bears on?

analytical_dimensions.description: What the owner does with an element of the thinker's
probing_questions: Absorb, translate, refuse or defer — which concept or position, and why?
What must he confirm, restate, elaborate or choose for the encounter to settle?

analytical_dimensions.description: The thinker's text to read next
probing_questions: Which of the thinker's texts, held or not, would move the encounter furthest, and why?

engine_name: The encounter drafted: axes, relations, takes, the route in
problematique: Over the map and the owner's argument and hunches: the two to four axes that organise the whole encounter, the relation of the owner's position to the thinker's on each (parallel · collides · overlaps then diverges · absorbs · irrelevant) with ours, theirs and the bridge and the parts it bears on, what the owner does with each of the thinker's elements (absorb · translate · refuse · defer), the questions back to him, and the texts of the thinker's to read next, ranked. The draft proposes; he decides; making the encounter is kept apart from rewriting his parts.
researcher_question: On which axes does the owner meet this thinker, what does he take from them and refuse, what must he settle, and what should he read next in them?
